one_liner: Locate any from-scratch code implementation in the book and trace what it depends on and enables.

key_terms.definition: Engine that records operations as a computation graph during the forward pass and propagates gradients backward via the chain rule.
Tokenization algorithm that starts from characters/bytes and iteratively merges the most frequent adjacent symbol pair into a new token.
Core attention formula, softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d_k))V, that weights value vectors by query-key similarity scaled by the key dimension.
Positional encoding that rotates query/key vector pairs by an angle proportional to token position, encoding relative position as rotation.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that freezes the pretrained weight matrix and adds a trainable low-rank update ΔW = BA.
Alignment loss that optimizes the log-ratio of preferred vs. rejected response log-probabilities against a reference model, avoiding an explicit reward model.
RL algorithm that samples a group of responses per prompt, normalizes rewards within the group into advantages, and optimizes a clipped surrogate without a value network.
IO-aware attention kernel that tiles Q/K/V into SRAM-sized blocks and computes softmax incrementally, avoiding materializing the full T x T score matrix in HBM.
Inference technique where a small draft model proposes several tokens that the target model verifies in one parallel forward pass, preserving the target's output distribution.
Pipeline that encodes and indexes text chunks, retrieves the top-k most similar chunks for a query, and feeds them as context to a generator model.
Decoding strategy that samples from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability mass exceeds a threshold p, adapting to the distribution's shape.

prerequisites: reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) basics
